Policy on My TypeScript Programming

Type Definition

Modules

  • Type definitions are done in types.ts

  • If they are complicated, do them in types/**/*.ts and re-export them in types/index.ts

  • The type definition module also contains guard functions

Naming Rules

  • Types use the -Type suffix, e.g. FooBarType.

  • Interfaces use the I- prefix, e.g. IFooBar.

  • Classes can be any PascalCase that does not fit the above patterns, but if you create a class that ends with Type, use the -Object suffix, e.g. -TypeObject.

  • Abstract classes use the Abstract- prefix.
